title: CALLING ALL ARTISTS — WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU! 🧧✨
content: CALLING ALL ARTISTS — WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU! 🧧✨ ColourSpace is seeking a talented visual artist to help shape a major 2027 Chinese New Year cultural celebration through a unique creative vision. We are seeking to commission an artist for two key deliverables: 🐐 Hero Mascot Design: Create an original mascot character suitable for production as a hero sculptural installation. 🖋️ Graphic Design: Develop up to five different poses of the same mascot character for use across merchandise, marketing, and promotional materials. Whether your practice spans visual art, character design, illustration, sculpture, or object design, we'd love to discover your unique artistic style! To Apply: Submit your existing portfolio, examples of your work, and a one-page preliminary concept design. A fully developed design is not required at this stage. 🗓️ EOI Closes: 21 October 2026 (5:00 PM AEST) ⏰ Final Design Deadline: Early November 2026 (for the selected artist) 🔗 Interested? Submit your Expression of Interest (EOI) via this link https://tinyurl.com/CNY2027Registration Know an artist who would be perfect?
